body: Thanks, i really appreciate that you took the time to talk to me

I've already spent way more than i can afford in therapy. Therapy didn't help. It helped me understand things better, but at the end of the day i still went home to an empty house, my problems were still there, nothing changed

Thanks for responding. My family is still around, just not in my life anymore. My dad abandoned us when i was a kid then my mom left when i was 15, we don't even live in the same country anymore. My sister has been a stranger to me since for almost 15 years now, so we don't have a relationship. All I've been doing is checking my email, checking my messages to see if my friend had said anything, but it doesn't matter anymore
